notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Attribute Scope Advisory callbacks and switch accessors to the official C++ API corpus. The implemented slice covers known object instances, committed regional overlap, update-region association, and ordinary or regional subscription transitions, immediate/evoked delivery, callback-time stale suppression, and the per-federate advisory switch. The narrow file-selected successful-void record for Set Attribute Scope Advisory Switch is traced separately in mom-service-reporting-requirements-contract.json; generic MOM behavior and interaction delivery remain outside this slice. Default-region synthesis, timestamped/retraction behavior, save/restore, remote transport, package support, protected review, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
